sources.title: rank_bm25 README
sources.confirmed: BM25Okapi takes tokenized documents and callers apply matching preprocessing to queries.
sources.limits: The README does not set a Korean tokenizer or show effectiveness on this corpus.

sources.title: Sentence Transformers semantic textual similarity
sources.confirmed: Cosine is the default similarity and normalized dot product is equivalent.
sources.limits: The examples do not establish cross-language retrieval quality for this design task.

sources.title: Multilingual E5 Small
sources.sections_read: Usage, Supported Languages and FAQ, L101–144 and L210–223
sources.confirmed: The card specifies asymmetric query and passage prefixes, masked pooling, normalization and 384 dimensions.
sources.limits: The card does not show that the pinned artifact is available to this execution environment.

sources.title: Multilingual E5 Text Embeddings
sources.confirmed: The authors train multilingual E5 contrastively and report multilingual retrieval and bitext results.
sources.limits: Those tasks do not establish results for design questions or for the fallback.

sources.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
sources.confirmed: RRF adds reciprocal ranks with offset 60 in the authors' trials. Used for the formula, as already discussed in AF-RES-002 METHODS.md.
sources.limits: The study does not prove RRF gains on the present query inventory.

sources.title: Overview of TREC 2004
sources.sections_read: Pool construction and quality, pp. 3–4 L116–139
sources.confirmed: Judging a top-depth pool leaves items outside the pool implicitly nonrelevant for scoring. Pool depth and diversity affect quality.
sources.limits: Agreement between tested methods cannot establish that the pool is exhaustive.

sources.title: TfidfVectorizer
sources.confirmed: Text becomes a TF-IDF feature matrix, equivalent to counting then transforming.
sources.limits: The documentation does not give cross-language alignment or robust negation.

sources.title: TruncatedSVD
sources.confirmed: Uncentered truncated SVD over sparse TF-IDF matrices is latent semantic analysis.
sources.limits: Results depend on the sample vocabulary and projection dimension.

sources.title: arc42
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. The proven template for documenting software architecture.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The template supplies no measured retrieval benefit.

sources.title: OpenAPI
sources.sections_read: Abstract and Introduction, L47 and L269–271
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a standard, programming language-agnostic interface description for HTTP APIs
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Design links do not guarantee successful invocation.

sources.title: AsyncAPI
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a project used to describe message-driven APIs in a machine-readable format.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Correlation alone cannot guarantee completion, order or exactly-once processing.

sources.title: Structurizr DSL
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. By default, the Structurizr DSL will create “implied relationships” automatically.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. An implied link does not demonstrate direct communication.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. an extensible, interoperable framework for expressing annotations such that they can easily be shared between platforms
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Offsets can drift after edits and selectors do not preserve the full source.

sources.title: W3C PROV-DM
sources.sections_read: Abstract and PROV bundles, L35 and L344
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. the conceptual data model that forms a basis for the W3C provenance (PROV) family of specifications.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Recorded provenance does not validate content truth or product substitutability.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. an executable file that can receive telemetry, process it, and export it to multiple targets, such as observability backends.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Pipeline configuration does not establish runtime behavior of a specific build.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Collector Persistent Sending Queue
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. enable persistent storage for the sending queue using the file_storage extension.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Disk exhaustion, queue capacity and retry limits can still cause loss without an external broker.

sources.title: Paperless-ngx
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Version-specific duplicate deletion and folder consumption can remove original input files.

sources.title: Automerge Conflicts
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. contains the conflicting values, both the “winner” and any “losers”.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. An application must build conflict review, and this does not capture every semantic conflict.

sources.title: Automerge Repo with IndexedDBStorageAdapter
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. stores data in an IndexedDB in the browser.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. New remote edits cannot arrive under permanent isolation, and the public example server is experimental.

sources.title: HTTP 202 Accepted
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. the request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. It supplies no completion guarantee, job identifier or callback route.

sources.title: GitHub Code Search
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. lets you rapidly search, navigate and understand your code, your team's code, and the code of the open source community.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Generated, vendored and other excluded files can stay out of the index.

sources.title: OSSInsight
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a powerful insight tool that can help you analyze any GitHub repository or developer.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Repository popularity does not establish design suitability.

sources.title: Paperless-ng
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a fork of the original project, adding a new interface and many other changes under the hood.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Its successor recommendation does not verify all data migrations or functional equivalence.

sources.title: Docspell
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. extract and attach metadata from each document
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Errors can leave incomplete items, and concurrent publication uniqueness is unverified.

sources.title: Docspell JOEX
sources.sections_read: File Conversion and Text Extraction, L210–241
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Plaintext files are treated as markdown.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Its internal steps are not established as an independently reusable library.

sources.title: OCRmyPDF
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. adds an optical character recognition (OCR) text layer to scanned PDF files, allowing them to be searched.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The example supplies neither a durable retry ledger nor unique document publication.

sources.title: Celery
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. communicates via messages, usually using a broker to mediate between clients and workers.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Reused task identifiers do not guarantee duplicate-free effects or redelivery.

sources.title: BullMQ Idempotent Jobs
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a fast and robust distributed job and message queue.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The application is responsible for idempotent effects.

sources.title: Spring Batch
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. A lightweight, comprehensive batch framework designed to enable the development of robust batch applications vital for the daily operations of enterprise systems.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. External file effects can fall outside a database chunk transaction.

sources.title: Bazel Remote Cache
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. A remote cache is used by a team of developers and/or a continuous integration (CI) system to share build outputs.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Untracked inputs can invalidate reuse, and publication uniqueness requires another mechanism.

sources.title: SQLite Atomic Commit
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Atomic commit means that either all database changes within a single transaction occur or none of them occur.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Database atomicity does not extend to arbitrary file moves or messages.

sources.title: GRAIL Reflow
sources.sections_read: README intro and Quickstart, L168 and L201–203
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a system for incremental data processing in the cloud.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Its deployment and duplicate-free publication for documents were unverified.

sources.title: Jiandu
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Self-hosted document management for one household.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. There are no public release packages or project license in the checked documentation.

sources.title: Joplin
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. an open source note-taking app.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Shared notebooks are documented for Joplin Cloud, with self-hosted feature parity unverified.

sources.title: Yjs
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a high-performance CRDT for building collaborative applications that sync automatically.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Persistence and networking need separate providers, and convergence alone does not expose semantic conflicts.

sources.title: y-indexeddb
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Adding offline support with y-indexeddb.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Offline app shell loading needs another mechanism, and quota handling was untested.

sources.title: CouchDB Replication Conflict Model
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Replication of databases takes place over HTTP, and can be either a “pull” or a “push”, but is unidirectional.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Compaction may discard non-leaf versions, and a fully offline editor is separate.

sources.title: Grafana Alloy
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. an OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with built-in Prometheus pipelines
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Agent variants need individual migration and equivalence checks.

sources.title: SQLite FTS5
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. an SQLite virtual table module that provides full-text search functionality to database applications.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Build inclusion and index consistency depend on configuration and application maintenance.

sources.title: SQLite Session Extension
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a convenient mechanism to record changes to tables in an SQLite database
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. It excludes virtual tables and folds net-zero changes, so intermediate events may disappear.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Logging
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) is a standard method for ensuring data integrity.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Its disk format and operational contract are specific to PostgreSQL.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Logical Decoding
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. extracting all persistent changes to a database's tables into a coherent, easy to understand format
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. A crash can replay changes and requires idempotent consumers.

sources.title: Event Sourcing
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Each event is recorded in an append-only store.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Simple CRUD or static reference data may not justify the complexity.

sources.title: SQLite FTS3 and FTS4
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. SQLite virtual table modules that allow users to perform full-text searches on a set of documents.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The shared FTS3/4 interface does not imply FTS5 compatibility.

sources.title: URI Syntax and Comparison
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a compact sequence of characters that identifies an abstract or physical resource.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Equivalence for retrieval does not establish product identity or future content.

sources.title: BIBFRAME 2.0
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. organizes this information into three core levels of abstraction: Work, Instance, and Item.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The levels do not directly prescribe software entities or user-facing tasks.

sources.title: JSON Patch RFC 6902
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a JSON document structure for expressing a sequence of operations to apply to a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) document
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The format supplies no order-independent merge or offline persistence mechanism.

sources.title: RabbitMQ Quorum Queues
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a durable, replicated queue based on the Raft consensus algorithm
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The default redelivery limit of 20 can drop or dead-letter repeatedly interrupted work.

sources.title: Redis Pub/Sub
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Redis' Pub/Sub exhibits at-most-once message delivery semantics.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. A disconnected consumer permanently misses messages because there is no redelivery.

sources.title: Amazon SQS Standard
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Amazon SQS stores copies of your messages on multiple servers for redundancy and high availability.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Handlers must tolerate duplicates, and retention and visibility require configuration.

sources.title: Amazon SQS FIFO
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. FIFO queues help you avoid sending duplicates to a queue.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Visibility has a twelve-hour bound, and send deduplication does not prevent repeated consumer effects.

sources.title: Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. it remains in the queue but becomes temporarily invisible to other consumers.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The lease neither extends beyond twelve hours from first receipt nor commits effects atomically.

sources.title: asyncio.Queue
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. A first in, first out (FIFO) queue.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Limiting in-flight work requires a fixed worker set or other admission control.

sources.title: asyncio.Semaphore
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. A semaphore manages an internal counter which is decremented by each acquire() call and incremented by each release() call.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Already created tasks can form an unbounded waiting population.

sources.title: Reactive Streams
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a standard for asynchronous stream processing with non-blocking backpressure.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Worker completion must determine when to request more in a Python adaptation.

sources.title: Toyota Just-in-Time Pull
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Only make what is needed by the customer, when it is needed, and in the amount needed
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. An exact software concurrency bound requires an explicit permit and completion mapping.

sources.title: restic
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a modern backup program that can back up your files
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Restores require the credentials and actual recoverability requires a restore check.

sources.title: BorgBackup
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a deduplicating backup program. Optionally, it supports compression and authenticated encryption.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. The example assumes available keys and does not establish real restore success.

sources.title: rsync
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. a fast and extraordinarily versatile file copying tool.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. A single delete-enabled mirror supplies neither retained versions nor encryption at rest.

sources.title: Certificate Transparency Merkle Inclusion
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. the list of missing nodes required to compute the nodes leading from a leaf to the root of the tree.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. Manifest use requires deterministic leaf encoding and trusted roots and cannot restore encrypted file contents.

sources.title: Automerge Core
sources.confirmed: The publisher describes the entry as follows. Automerge documents are composed of nested maps and lists or simple values or text sequences.
sources.limits: This excerpt establishes the publisher wording only. A storage adapter is required for persistent reopen and convergence allows visible winners.

sources.title: paperless
sources.confirmed: A notebook execution tool runs Papermill notebooks in Dataproc Serverless.
sources.limits: The package describes notebook execution and gives no folder document ingestion contract.

sources.title: pdf2image
sources.confirmed: A conversion wrapper turns PDF pages into PIL images via pdftoppm and pdftocairo.
sources.limits: The metadata covers image conversion and leaves OCR and job retries unverified.

sources.title: pypdf
sources.confirmed: A PDF utility library manipulates files by splitting, merging, cropping and transformation in Python.
sources.limits: The metadata does not establish scanned document OCR or a searchable catalogue.

sources.title: pytesseract
sources.confirmed: An optical recognition wrapper makes Tesseract OCR callable from Python.
sources.limits: The package summary leaves storage durability and failure isolation unverified.

sources.title: pdfplumber
sources.confirmed: A PDF extraction library exposes characters, rectangles and lines for detailed inspection.
sources.limits: The package summary does not establish OCR on corrupted scans or retry safety.

sources.title: unstructured
sources.confirmed: A document preprocessing library prepares raw inputs for downstream machine learning.
sources.limits: Output publication semantics and local deployment are unverified here.

sources.title: dedupe
sources.confirmed: A Python data library reduces duplicate records through entity resolution.
sources.limits: The registry purpose does not establish byte-identical file ingestion or atomic publication.

sources.title: filetype
sources.confirmed: A dependency-free file probe infers file or buffer type and MIME information.
sources.limits: Type inference does not establish that a document can be decoded successfully.

sources.title: watchdog
sources.confirmed: An event monitoring library observes filesystem events for file watchers.
sources.limits: The registry summary does not describe deduplication or a durable job ledger.

sources.title: watchfiles
sources.confirmed: A Python watcher reacts to file changes and reloads code.
sources.limits: Restart recovery and input-file preservation are unverified.

sources.title: rq
sources.confirmed: A background processing library creates and processes job records.
sources.limits: The package summary leaves retention, acknowledgements and duplicates unspecified.

sources.title: dramatiq
sources.confirmed: A Python 3 package provides background processing for asynchronous jobs.
sources.limits: The short description gives no worker crash or broker failure guarantee.

sources.title: huey
sources.confirmed: A compact task queue enqueues work for task processing.
sources.limits: The registry does not specify acknowledgement or retry safety in this summary.

sources.title: arq
sources.confirmed: A Python job queue combines asyncio work processing with Redis.
sources.limits: The headline alone leaves Redis durability and side effect idempotency unverified.

sources.title: taskiq
sources.confirmed: A distributed task queue supports asynchronous job execution.
sources.limits: The registry summary leaves broker mode and durable delivery unverified.

sources.title: apscheduler
sources.confirmed: A scheduler triggers tasks in process using cron-like schedules.
sources.limits: Scheduling by time does not establish durable redelivery after a broker failure.

sources.title: kombu
sources.confirmed: A Python messaging library provides an interface for message-based communication.
sources.limits: Broker deployment and redelivery policies are unspecified in the package description.

sources.title: pika
sources.confirmed: An AMQP client library lets Python code communicate using AMQP.
sources.limits: Client identity alone does not establish durable broker queues or policies.

sources.title: aio-pika
sources.confirmed: A messaging wrapper adapts aiormq for asyncio applications.
sources.limits: A wrapper does not specify broker retention or replication settings.

sources.title: redis
sources.confirmed: A Python Redis client interfaces with the key-value database.
sources.limits: The client package summary does not select Redis persistence or delivery semantics.

sources.title: aiosqlite
sources.confirmed: An asyncio bridge exposes the standard sqlite3 interface for async code.
sources.limits: The registry does not establish a full-text build or bounded job admission.

sources.title: aiolimiter
sources.confirmed: An asyncio rate limiter uses a leaky bucket to meter admission.
sources.limits: The stated rate limit leaves completion-driven concurrency unverified.

sources.title: aiojobs
sources.confirmed: An asyncio scheduler manages background tasks as scheduled jobs.
sources.limits: The registry summary leaves queue depth and producer backpressure unspecified.

sources.title: janus
sources.confirmed: A mixed queue connects asyncio tasks and traditional threads through synchronous and asynchronous interfaces.
sources.limits: The metadata does not establish a fixed in-flight worker limit.

sources.title: rx
sources.confirmed: A Python reactive library brings Reactive Extensions to asynchronous data processing.
sources.limits: The version metadata does not demonstrate requested-demand compliance or completion-based limits.

sources.title: limits
sources.confirmed: A utility package provides rate limiting for controlling the pace of operations.
sources.limits: The summary leaves queue and concurrent in-flight limits unverified.

sources.title: backoff
sources.confirmed: Function decorators schedule backoff and retry for interrupted calls.
sources.limits: Retrying a call does not establish its idempotent effects or persistence across restarts.

sources.title: tenacity
sources.confirmed: A retry utility repeats a code operation until successful according to its listed purpose.
sources.limits: The registry does not verify durable work records or duplicate-free publication.

sources.title: peewee
sources.confirmed: A compact object-relational mapper connects application objects to database records.
sources.limits: The summary alone does not specify search, offline synchronization or restore behavior.

sources.title: sqlite-utils
sources.confirmed: A SQLite toolkit exposes database manipulation through a Python library and command-line interface.
sources.limits: The short metadata does not specify Korean retrieval or a decision rationale schema.

sources.title: whoosh
sources.confirmed: A pure-Python retrieval library indexes full text and offers search and spelling checks.
sources.limits: Korean analysis and handling of decision rationale are unverified.

sources.title: lunr
sources.confirmed: A Python search library implements the Lunr.js interface.
sources.limits: The metadata does not establish a complete local Markdown decision log or Korean support.

sources.title: mkdocs
sources.confirmed: A documentation tool uses Markdown to produce project documentation.
sources.limits: The summary does not give a decision rationale model or a Korean result requirement.

sources.title: markdown
sources.confirmed: A document library implements John Gruber's Markdown in Python.
sources.limits: Format support alone leaves local search and finding decision rationale unverified.

sources.title: dulwich
sources.confirmed: A Git library provides a Python interface to version-control tooling.
sources.limits: The registry summary does not describe a note conflict interface or export workflow.

sources.title: borgmatic
sources.confirmed: A backup tool uses configuration to manage backups on workstations and servers.
sources.limits: The short summary leaves keyless access protection and historical restore configuration unverified.

sources.title: rdiff-backup
sources.confirmed: A backup and restoration utility supports both local and remote use.
sources.limits: Encryption and exact historical retention are unverified in the package summary.

sources.title: duplicity
sources.confirmed: A backup utility encrypts backups and uses the rsync algorithm.
sources.limits: Local version selection and restoration were not verified from the registry summary.

sources.title: pymerkle
sources.confirmed: A Python cryptography library uses a Merkle tree structure.
sources.limits: Manifest encoding, trusted roots and restore integration remain unspecified.

sources.title: opentelemetry-api
sources.confirmed: An instrumentation package exposes the OpenTelemetry API to Python applications.
sources.limits: The SDK-facing package does not document a Collector persistence configuration.

sources.title: opentelemetry-sdk
sources.confirmed: A telemetry SDK provides OpenTelemetry software interfaces for instrumenting Python.
sources.limits: The registry package description does not establish a Collector disk queue.

sources.title: opentelemetry-exporter-otlp
sources.confirmed: A telemetry exporter package provides Collector exporters under its OTLP package identity.
sources.limits: The package summary does not establish durable Collector queuing or restart recovery.

sources.title: prometheus-client
sources.confirmed: A monitoring client interfaces with Prometheus from Python.
sources.limits: The metadata does not claim trace export or disk-backed restart recovery.

sources.title: fastapi
sources.confirmed: A web API framework provides a Python framework for defining application endpoints.
sources.limits: A framework description leaves asynchronous status and result correlation design unspecified.

sources.title: connexion
sources.confirmed: An API-first framework defines applications through OpenAPI or Swagger contracts.
sources.limits: The registry description does not verify callback delivery or accepted-job semantics.

sources.title: y-websocket
sources.confirmed: A synchronization provider transports Yjs updates through WebSocket connections.
sources.limits: The package title does not guarantee persistence while completely disconnected.

sources.title: y-webrtc
sources.confirmed: A Yjs provider connects peers via WebRTC for collaborative synchronization.
sources.limits: Peer communication requires connectivity and offline persistence is unspecified.

sources.title: y-protocols
sources.confirmed: A Yjs library encodes coordination data with shared protocols.
sources.limits: Encoding does not establish a user-facing conflict view or durable storage.

sources.title: sharedb
sources.confirmed: A collaboration backend handles JSON documents through operational transformation.
sources.limits: The metadata does not establish offline reopen or user export.

sources.title: pouchdb
sources.confirmed: A compact database library stores data as a small database component.
sources.limits: The version summary alone leaves browser persistence and conflict behavior unverified.

sources.title: localforage
sources.confirmed: A storage library provides an offline storage interface.
sources.limits: The short metadata leaves concurrency, merge and recovery behavior unspecified.

sources.title: dexie
sources.confirmed: A database wrapper simplifies browser IndexedDB access.
sources.limits: Persistent storage access alone leaves change merge and collaborative editing unspecified.

sources.title: idb
sources.confirmed: A small browser storage wrapper provides an interface for IndexedDB.
sources.limits: The metadata does not specify replica synchronization or conflict resolution.

sources.title: jsondiffpatch
sources.confirmed: A document change library computes and applies JSON differences for objects, arrays and text.
sources.limits: Patch operations do not demonstrate order-independent concurrent merge.

sources.title: p-queue
sources.confirmed: A JavaScript promise queue controls concurrency of asynchronous jobs.
sources.limits: Its stated runtime and interface differ from Python asyncio.

sources.title: p-limit
sources.confirmed: A JavaScript utility limits concurrent Promise-returning and asynchronous function calls.
sources.limits: The registry summary does not give a Python queue bound or producer wait policy.

sources.title: bottleneck
sources.confirmed: A distributed work scheduler meters the pace of tasks using rate limiting.
sources.limits: The registry summary alone does not establish completion-driven backpressure in asyncio.

sources.title: merkle-tree
sources.confirmed: A Merkle tree skeleton implements a starting structure in IcedCoffeeScript.
sources.limits: The package summary does not specify proof verification or backups.

sources.title: merkletreejs
sources.confirmed: A JavaScript library constructs Merkle trees and verifies proofs.
sources.limits: A verifier still needs agreed leaf encoding and trusted roots for a manifest.

sources.title: workbox-background-sync
sources.confirmed: A web retry component queues failed requests for replay by the Background Sync API after connectivity returns.
sources.limits: Request replay does not establish a durable backend job result or merge of notes.

sources.title: lowdb
sources.confirmed: A local JSON database stores data on Node, Electron or in a browser.
sources.limits: The summary does not establish shared document merge or historical snapshot protection.

sources.title: level
sources.confirmed: An abstract-level database interface supports Node.js and browser data storage.
sources.limits: The metadata does not describe conflict controls or encrypted historic backup.

sources.title: async
sources.confirmed: A JavaScript utility offers higher-order functions and patterns for asynchronous code.
sources.limits: The package summary does not establish bounded admission in Python.

sources.title: json-stable-stringify
sources.confirmed: A serializer creates deterministic JSON with custom sorting for repeatable hashes.
sources.limits: A serialized leaf still needs a proof and trusted root.

sources.title: simple-git
sources.confirmed: A command interface provides access to Git from Node.js.
sources.limits: Tool invocation alone does not provide a user conflict workflow or note export.
